messages:
Mira (PM): Heads up — competitor launched a feature parity play this morning around structured function/tool outputs and streaming hooks. Sales already flagged churn risk. Need quick sync on whether we accelerate parity or lean into our differentiators.
Alex (Eng): Can you paste the ask from the customer / competitor link? quick glance -> looks like streamed tool calls + a JSON-first output mode.
Priya (Sales): Customer: FinGuard asked about this at 10am, said they might pilot elsewhere if we don't deliver an equivalent in 6-8 weeks. Link: https://example.com/comp-release (internal).
